findings.message: The source quantifies over every integer k ≠ 1 and explicitly discusses k = -1, but Lean elaborates this as every natural k > 1. This omits k = 0 and all negative integers, so it formalises a strictly narrower problem.
findings.suggestion: Replace the statement with `answer(sorry) ↔ ∀ k : ℤ, k ≠ 1 → { n : ℕ | (2 : ℤ) ^ n ≡ k [ZMOD n] }.Infinite`; this replacement typechecks.
